text:
Elaine: noticed weird CSR burst to signing-service in eu-west ~03:12 UTC; requestor shows 'proxy-provisioner' which we don't expect to call CA.
Kishore: paste CSR subject/thumbprint and audit snippet?
Elaine: subject=CN=svc.proxy.edge.eu-west, O=redwood; sha256=3b7c...; audit: `2026-03-18T03:12:05Z INFO RequestReceived uid=6f2a authn=proxy-provisioner region=eu-west action=create_csr`
opsec-bot: alert: csr-spike-eu-west 1 events in 3m for pattern 'svc.proxy.edge.*' (rule: ephemeral-csr-spike)
Samir: we applied a small RBAC tweak at 02:45 to allow proxy-provisioner scoped signing for canary nodes. Could be related.
Kishore: I added the rule; intended CN glob 'canary-*' but might have been mis-specified.
Mina: Did CA actually sign any?
Elaine: Two certs show signed=true with 1h TTL.
Kishore: Immediate: revoke, tighten RBAC, pull KMS:Decrypt for signing key, stash evidence.
Samir: running revoke now: `./signingctl revoke --region eu-west --filter "subject:svc.proxy.edge*" --reason "misissue"`
Elaine: revoke complete 1 certs revoked; serials 0x4a2f...,0x4a30...
Kishore: forensic list: signing-service audit, KMS decrypt logs (key=signing-key-eu-west), IAM policy changes, edge-proxy traces.
Mina: opsec-bot shows 3 kms:Decrypt by principal 'svc-kms-eu-mid' in the window. That's our regional agent but verify mapping.
Kishore: short-term fixes: rollback the permissive change, enforce server-side CN validation in signing-service, add CSR subject allowlist, log full caller provenance (token id, SNI, IP).
Elaine: propose issuing a new intermediate signed by root KMS key and swap issuance rather than rotating root.
Kishore: I'll open the rollback PR with tightened condition: `StringLike subject: "canary-*"`. Also add CI check for IAM condition globs.
Samir: I'll collect logs and package for incident. Elaine, can you pull x-request-ids from edge-proxy for those serials?
Elaine: grabbing traces now, will post to incident channel.
Mina: follow-ups: server-side CSR validation, Prom metrics for csr.requestor_identity and kms_key_id, auto-pause policy if >3 unexpected CSRs in 5m.
opsec-bot: incident_created: incident/7512345678 1 investigators assigned: @samir @kishore @elaine. Next update in 30m.
